title: On Laying the boards across the ditch
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：lay　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lay 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the postman ① laid the boards across the ditch without a word of thanks, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② lays the boards across the ditch at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ lay the boards across the ditch at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ laid the boards across the ditch before — a line in the list for June 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Laying the boards across the ditch without a word of thanks, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ lay two eggs every morning at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Lay two eggs every morning at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ lays two eggs every morning without a word of thanks every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ laid the boards across the ditch again when nobody else would.

⑩ To lay the boards across the ditch, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody lays the boards across the ditch at once again and somebody must lay the boards across the ditch without a word of thanks all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lay 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the postman laid the boards across the ditch without a word of thanks, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman lays the boards across the ditch at once whenever the office asks.
Laying the boards across the ditch without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever lay two eggs every morning at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sender from the next office lays two eggs every morning without a word of thanks every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother laid the boards across the ditch again, and the office remembered that half.
